info.title: Ecurious assigned test hardware — BayReady observed integration
info.description: Separate upstream service used by the BayReady Audimax map demo and the Node read-only adapter. This is a repository-maintained integration subset, not an official Ecurious OpenAPI publication. Contract sources: docs/ECURIOUS-API.md and mobile/src/lib/audimax-lock-api.ts, reviewed 24 October 2026. The direct map flow raises the assigned barrier, installs a plate whitelist, and later clears the whitelist and lowers the barrier. Booking windows, owner allocation and mock fees belong to BayReady; this provider has no documented booking/payment/charging endpoint. All examples are fictional. Requests in this document go directly to the Ecurious service and can operate the assigned test rig.

servers.description: Ecurious challenge service; assigned lock-0002 is the BayReady barrier-only demo rig

tags.name: Assigned locks
tags.description: Provider-reported telemetry, including potentially historical state and personal data.

tags.name: Camera OCR
tags.description: Read the most recent onboard OCR result; a result may predate the active booking.

tags.name: Barrier commands
tags.description: Real assigned test-hardware movement requests; acknowledgement and observed movement are separate.

tags.name: Plate access
tags.description: Persistent onboard-camera rules for automatic plate-triggered lowering. No provider TTL is documented.

get.summary: List locks assigned to the API key
get.description: The phone accepts either locks or assignedLocks. carPresence is a string, not a carPresent boolean. whitelist and latestPhoto may contain raw plate data; the Node /api/hardware endpoint returns a separate redacted projection.

200.description: Team-scoped assigned locks. Optional telemetry fields may be absent.

default.description: Provider-defined error response (including authentication, assignment, missing lock or device errors). The full error-body contract has not been independently established.

get.description: Returns the provider lock object. lastSeenAt is the device observation time; receiving HTTP 200 does not make it current.

default.description: Provider-defined error response (including authentication, assignment, missing lock or device errors). The full error-body contract has not been independently established.

get.summary: Retrieve the latest onboard-camera OCR result
get.description: Observed response keys are lockId, timestamp, licensePlate and plateType. No confidence score, event ID or OCR-injection endpoint was observed. A historical result is not proof of a new arrival. The direct Audimax client uses hardware whitelist auto-entry rather than polling this endpoint.

200.description: Latest recognition, potentially historical. Contains personal data.

404.description: Observed when no latest recognition is available; an unknown/unassigned lock may also be unavailable. No recognition does not establish vacancy.

default.description: Provider-defined error response (including authentication, assignment, missing lock or device errors). The full error-body contract has not been independently established.

post.description: The Audimax Reserve flow sends this POST without a JSON body, then sends a separate whitelist POST. These two operations are not atomic. This endpoint changes hardware state; it does not create a BayReady booking. The Node adapter uses the optional documented body instead.

requestBody.description: The current Audimax phone client sends no request body. The separate Node adapter sends the documented optional cancelAutoLift:false object.

200.description: Command accepted/sent acknowledgement. This is not a sensor-confirmed barrier position.

default.description: Provider-defined error response (including authentication, assignment, missing lock or device errors). The full error-body contract has not been independently established.

post.description: The Audimax Leave flow first clears whitelist access, then sends this POST without a JSON body. The two operations are not atomic. HTTP success is a command acknowledgement, not proof of the final arm position.

requestBody.description: The current Audimax phone client sends no request body. The separate Node adapter sends the documented optional cancelAutoLift:false object.

200.description: Command accepted/sent acknowledgement. This is not a sensor-confirmed barrier position.

default.description: Provider-defined error response (including authentication, assignment, missing lock or device errors). The full error-body contract has not been independently established.

post.summary: Replace plate access rules; use plates:[] to clear
post.description: The current phone flow sends a list of profile plates after raising and sends plates:[] before lowering. The documented camera stores up to ten entries and automatically lowers for a matching plate. wildcard:true is documented by the provider; normal BayReady demo reservations install a specific plate. Rules are persistent, with no documented per-booking expiry or rollback. This configures future access; it does not inject an OCR observation.

200.description: Provider acknowledgement with whitelist echo; not an independent hardware readback.

default.description: Provider-defined error response (including authentication, assignment, missing lock or device errors). The full error-body contract has not been independently established.

ecuriousQueryKey.name: apiKey
ecuriousQueryKey.description: Team API key. The current Expo Audimax client uses this query parameter. Enter locally in Authorize; no key is embedded in this specification.

ecuriousHeaderKey.name: X-API-Key
ecuriousHeaderKey.description: Documented alternative used by the Node Ecurious adapter. Supply either query or header authentication.

lockId.name: lockId
lockId.description: Currently assigned hardware ID. lock-0002 is the designated BayReady barrier-only demo.

AssignedLocksResponse.description: The provider list uses locks; the participant dashboard and phone also tolerate assignedLocks. At least one array is needed by the integration.

Lock.description: Observed integration fields. Optional/missing/unfamiliar telemetry must remain unknown; fields and status values are not claimed exhaustive.

status.description: Observed/documented values include raised, lowered, raising, lowering and offline. This is barrier telemetry, not reservation status.

carPresence.description: Known string values are vacant and occupied; do not coerce this string into a boolean.

signalStrength4G.description: Provider signal value; no scale contract established.

lastSeenAt.description: Last provider device observation, not the HTTP fetch time.

whitelist.description: May contain personal data and the wildcard marker *. No automatic expiry is established.

licensePlate.description: Raw OCR plate; fictional examples only.

cancelAutoLift.description: Provider option; true disables the documented automatic relift timeout. Duration and complete interactions are not established. The Node adapter sends false.

CommandAcknowledgement.description: Subset from documented command examples. The Node adapter requires both success and result.success to be true. The direct phone currently checks HTTP success only.

plates.description: Use one specific plate for a BayReady reservation, or an empty array to disable plate-triggered entry.

wildcard.description: Provider-documented any-plate access, separate from the normal specific-plate reservation flow.
